speaker: dad
igboText: Nwa nwa m nwanyị, ka m kọọrọ gị otu akụkọ Igbo ochie.
englishText: Granddaughter, let me tell you an old Igbo story.
statement: Dad tells his granddaughter he wants to share an old Igbo story.
falseStatement: Dad says he does not want to tell any story.

speaker: granddaughter
igboText: Ana m ege gị ntị, Nnaochie.
englishText: I'm listening, Grandpa.
statement: The granddaughter says she is listening.
falseStatement: The granddaughter says she is not listening.

speaker: dad
igboText: Otu nwa agbọghọ zutere otu nwa okorobịa mara ezigbo mma.
englishText: A young girl met a very handsome young man.
statement: Dad says a young girl met a very handsome young man.
falseStatement: Dad says a young girl met an old woman.

speaker: granddaughter
igboText: Ọ masịrị ya?
englishText: Did she like him?
statement: The granddaughter asks if the girl liked him.
falseStatement: The granddaughter asks if he liked her family.

speaker: dad
igboText: Ee, nke ukwuu. Ọ chọrọ ịlụ ya.
englishText: Very much. She wanted to marry him.
statement: Dad says she liked him very much and wanted to marry him.
falseStatement: Dad says she did not want to marry him.

speaker: granddaughter
igboText: Gịnị ka ezinụlọ ya kwuru?
englishText: What did her family say?
statement: The granddaughter asks what the family said.
falseStatement: The granddaughter asks what the young man said first.

speaker: dad
igboText: Ha kwuru, "Anyi amaghị ezinụlọ ya ma ọ bụ ebe o si."
englishText: "We don't know his family or where he's from."
statement: Dad says her family did not know his family or where he came from.
falseStatement: Dad says her family knew him very well.

speaker: granddaughter
igboText: Nke ahụ nwere ezi uche.
englishText: That sounds reasonable.
statement: The granddaughter says that sounds reasonable.
falseStatement: The granddaughter says that sounds foolish.

speaker: dad
igboText: Ha kwuru, "Ka anyị buru ụzọ mụtakwuo gbasara ya."
englishText: They said, "Let's learn more about him first."
statement: Dad says the family wanted to learn more about him first.
falseStatement: Dad says the family wanted a wedding immediately.

speaker: granddaughter
igboText: Ọ gere ha ntị?
englishText: Did she listen?
statement: The granddaughter asks whether the girl listened.
falseStatement: The granddaughter asks whether the family listened.

speaker: dad
igboText: Mba. Ọ na-ahụ naanị ihu mara mma ya.
englishText: No. She only saw his handsome face.
statement: Dad says she only focused on his handsome face.
falseStatement: Dad says she looked deeply into his character.

speaker: granddaughter
igboText: Gịnị ka ọ chọrọ?
englishText: What did she want?
statement: The granddaughter asks what the girl wanted.
falseStatement: The granddaughter asks what the family wanted.

speaker: dad
igboText: Ọ chọrọ ụmụ mara mma n'aka ya.
englishText: She wanted beautiful children with him.
statement: Dad says she wanted beautiful children with him.
falseStatement: Dad says she wanted to move away alone.

speaker: granddaughter
igboText: Mgbe ahụ gịnị mere?
englishText: Then what happened?
statement: The granddaughter asks what happened next.
falseStatement: The granddaughter asks what happened before they met.

speaker: dad
igboText: Ọ kpọgara ya ebe dị anya n'ala mmụọ.
englishText: He took her far away to the land of spirits.
statement: Dad says he took her far away to the land of spirits.
falseStatement: Dad says he took her to visit her family.

speaker: granddaughter
igboText: Ọ bụ ezi nwoke n'ezie?
englishText: Was he really a man?
statement: The granddaughter asks whether he was truly a man.
falseStatement: The granddaughter asks whether he was from her village.

speaker: dad
igboText: Mba. O gosiri na ọ bụ okpokoro isi.
englishText: No. He revealed he was a skull.
statement: Dad says he revealed himself as a skull.
falseStatement: Dad says he revealed he was a prince.

speaker: granddaughter
igboText: Okpokoro isi?!
englishText: A skull?!
statement: The granddaughter reacts in shock.
falseStatement: The granddaughter reacts calmly with no surprise.

speaker: dad
igboText: Ee. Ịma mma ya bụ naanị aghụghọ.
englishText: Yes. His beauty was only a disguise.
statement: Dad says his beauty was only a disguise.
falseStatement: Dad says his beauty showed his true character.

speaker: granddaughter
igboText: Kedu ka akụkọ ahụ kwụsịrị?
englishText: How did the story end?
statement: The granddaughter asks how the story ended.
falseStatement: The granddaughter asks how the story began.

speaker: dad
igboText: Ọ mụtara na ọdịdị n'èzí nwere ike ịghọgbu mmadụ.
englishText: She learned that appearances can deceive.
statement: Dad says she learned that appearances can deceive.
falseStatement: Dad says she learned that appearances are always true.

speaker: granddaughter
igboText: Gịnị bụ nkuzi ya, Nnaochie?
englishText: What's the lesson, Grandpa?
statement: The granddaughter asks for the lesson.
falseStatement: The granddaughter asks for the story title.

speaker: dad
igboText: Legharịa anya karịa ihu mara mma. Buru ụzọ mụta agwa mmadụ, ezinụlọ ya, na omume ya. 😄
englishText: Look beyond a beautiful face. Learn someone's character, family, and actions first. 😄
statement: Dad says we should look beyond beauty and learn a person's character, family, and actions first.
falseStatement: Dad says we should judge people only by their beautiful faces.
